description: Source code for the Android shared video decoder implementation in the Cobalt project, including classes and functions for handling video decoding, surface textures, and related media processing.

classes.name: VideoRenderAlgorithmTunneled
classes.description: Implementation of VideoRenderAlgorithm for tunneled mode, managing frame tracking and seeking.

classes.name: VideoDecoder::Sink
classes.description: Inner class implementing VideoRendererSink to handle rendering of video frames.

methods.name: IsSoftwareDecodeRequired
methods.description: Determines if software decoding is required based on max video capabilities string.

methods.name: ParseMaxResolution
methods.description: Parses maximum resolution constraints from max_video_capabilities string.

methods.name: GetCurrentDecodeTarget
methods.description: Returns the current decode target for decode-to-texture mode, updating texture if needed.

methods.name: UpdateDecodeTargetSizeAndContentRegion_Locked
methods.description: Updates the size and content region of the decode target based on current frame sizes and transform matrix.

methods.name: SetDecodeTargetContentRegionFromMatrix
methods.description: Converts a texture transform matrix into a content region rectangle.

methods.name: OnFrameRendered
methods.description: Callback invoked when a frame has been rendered, updates frame tracker.

methods.name: OnSurfaceDestroyed
methods.description: Handles surface destruction, releasing resources and stopping decoding.

methods.name: ReportError
methods.description: Reports a decoding error via callback.
